name: me.untype/aboard
title: aboard
description: Falsifiable claims about systemic problems: causal graph, forecasts, dossiers.

environmentVariables.name: ABOARD_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the aboard instance to read from. Defaults to the canonical deploy; set it to point the server at another instance.

environmentVariables.name: ABOARD_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Service token issued by the aboard operator. Needed only by the four write tools, each of which opens a pull request a human must review. The five read tools need no credential.
